messages:
amy: Heads-up: mini webinar launch tomorrow. Need X teaser + LinkedIn long-thread + 30s clip. Who owns copy + assets?
nate: I can write copy. Need clip mp4, thumbnail, transcript.
zoe: Ops will export clip + transcript by 10:00 PT. @chris can you do thumbnails + a GIF by 11am?
chris: Yep. Delivering 16:9 and 1:1 thumbs + 12s GIF. PNG + MP4.
amy: Timing: X teaser 08:45 PT, LI thread 11:30 PT, clip follow-up 24h later. Agree?
nate: Works. Messaging call: benchmark stat or customer-first? Benchmarks drive clicks but need legal.
zoe: Use anonymized stat as backup ("~2x inference cost reduction"). If legal delayed, swap to customer quote.
nate: Draft thread I'll drop at 07:30 for quick review. Plan: hook -> pain -> result (anonymized) -> how -> CTA.
chris: I'll make an image with the anonymized callout for LinkedIn. Use launch palette v3.
amy: Routing: tag signups as "miniweb-2026". Ops confirm CRM params?
zoe: Confirmed: source=social_x / social_li. SDRs get Slack + email pings.
publish-bot: Drafts queued: X teaser (08:45 PT), LI thread (11:30 PT). Will publish if approvals set by 07:15 PT.
amy: Approval flow: nate -> zoe -> legal (only if numbers). If legal not back by 07:15, remove hard numbers.
nate: I'll run A/B on first hook (tech vs customer) and report in 15m postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT.
zoe: Assets go to /shared/marketing/assets/miniweb-2026 by 10:30 — I'll ping here.
publish-bot: Once approval=YES posts will go live at scheduled times.
